profile.hero_headline: Rajesh Gund — Agricultural Robotics & Embedded Systems
profile.hero_subheadline: PhD student at the University of Tennessee, Knoxville, developing robotic and sensing systems for agricultural applications.
profile.availability: Open to engineering internships and full-time R&D roles in agricultural robotics, embedded systems, and precision sensing.

featured_projects.title: Autonomous Pest Trap Service Robot
featured_projects.subtitle: Deep Learning-Driven Insect Trap Detection & Mobile Manipulation for Large Food Storage Structures
featured_projects.status_badge: Phase I Demonstrated · Phase II In Progress
collaborators: Biosystems Engineering & Soil Science, University of Tennessee, Knoxville
USDA-ARS Center for Grain and Animal Health Research, Kansas
featured_projects.funding: USDA-NIFA Crop Protection and Pest Management Program (Award No. 2024-70006-42874)
problem_metrics: $100B annual insect-driven losses in U.S. grain and food industries (USDA-ARS)
10,000+ sq. ft. warehouse floor areas requiring manual pest trap collection
Grain storage losses from insect infestation: 9% (developed nations) and 30% (developing nations)

hardware.chassis: goBILDA Recon (low-profile differential-drive, 240mm x 240mm footprint, 40mm ground clearance, 600mm camera mast)
hardware.vision_sensor: Intel RealSense D455 (90° x 65° FOV, 0.6–6m range, downward eye-to-hand mount, RGB + Depth + IMU)

computer_vision.io: Input [x1, y1, x2, y2, x3, y3, x4, y4] -> Output [x, y, w, h, angle]

demonstrated_phase_1: Built low-profile differential-drive mobile robot integrating goBILDA Recon, Jetson Orin NX 8GB, and Intel RealSense D455
Curated and OBB-annotated 584 real-world trap images under varying lighting and complex backgrounds
Trained and benchmarked YOLOv8n-OBB detector for real-time edge deployment
in_progress_phase_2: Implementing ROS 2 framework across mobile platform and mobile manipulator
SLAM & navigation expansion with 2D LiDAR and Nav2 stack
Integrating 6-DOF robotic arm with dual-suction end-effector for trap manipulation

featured_projects.title: Wireless CO₂ Soil-Respiration Sensor
featured_projects.subtitle: Development and Validation of a Wireless and Low-Cost In-Chamber CO₂ Sensor for Measuring Real-Time Soil Respiration

hardware.mcu: Seeed Studio XIAO ESP32-C3 on custom PCB
hardware.dual_use: Fits inside both field soil chambers and lab glass incubation jars
hardware.expandability: Expandable framework for CH₄ and N₂O sensors

power_and_telemetry.sampling_schedule: 1-hour sampling interval with 55 minutes of deep sleep
power_and_telemetry.workflow: Sensing nodes (CO₂, Temp, RH, timestamp) -> Local Wi-Fi -> Central Node (ESP32 + LoRa Tx) -> Long-Range LoRa -> LoRa Rx + Raspberry Pi 5 base station
power_and_telemetry.base_station: Raspberry Pi 5 local data logger and real-time Web App server (live trend plots, historical date filter, CSV download; no internet gateway or cloud fees)

completed_work: First prototype built on perfboard in a rectangular mesh enclosure sized for field chambers
Custom PCB designed in KiCad, assembled and debugged with a Sensirion SCD30 and XIAO ESP32-C3
3D-printed PETG threaded capsule enclosure with ePTFE moisture barrier
About 20 days of battery runtime at hourly sampling and 55 minutes of deep sleep per cycle
Multi-node Wi-Fi to LoRa telemetry pipeline and Raspberry Pi 5 local real-time Web App with CSV export
Browser-based device configuration for sampling intervals, Wi-Fi setup and wireless CO₂ calibration
Dual-use form factor compatible with field chambers and laboratory incubation jars
planned_work: Further GC reference comparisons and soil-incubation testing
featured_projects.validation_update: Initial GC comparison and response-time tests completed; soil-incubation testing planned.

earlier_work.title: Computer Vision-Based Check-Row Rice Transplanting Control System (SRI Method)
earlier_work.summary: Developed a computer-vision control system using YOLOv8 for check-row rice transplanting under the System of Rice Intensification (SRI). Companion published study evaluated 12 nursery tray configurations and identified 80 g seed density with 25 mm soil height as optimal (1–3 seedlings/pick, <1% missing hills).

earlier_work.title: Precision Agriculture & Autonomous Ground Vehicle Systems
earlier_work.organization: CSIR–Central Mechanical Engineering Research Institute (CMERI), Ludhiana
earlier_work.summary: Embedded programming, mechatronics, CAD, and sensor troubleshooting for a Digital Cone Penetrometer, Variable Rate Fertilizer (VRT) system, AGV navigation system, and field mapping with SoilOptix and GreenSeeker under Senior Principal Scientist Dr. Pradeep Rajan.

earlier_work.title: Autonomous Tractor Three-Point Linkage Design
earlier_work.summary: Designed a custom three-point linkage in SolidWorks for an autonomous farm tractor, conducting force analysis covering implement draft, traction force, and tractor center of gravity.

earlier_work.title: Design of Litchi Decorticator
earlier_work.organization: Mahatma Phule Krishi Vidyapeeth, Rahuri (B.Tech. Project)
earlier_work.summary: Mechanical design of a litchi decorticator completed during undergraduate Agricultural Engineering studies.
